_comment: REAL passing fixture for audit-stranded-branches (ops#407). folio's default branch (also NOT `main` — folio's is claude/eloquent-ramanujan-9ag4uy, per the issue's own correction comment) is correctly excluded by API-reported name, and its two other branches both carry a PR, so nothing fires.
